_note: version 2：每个测点必须至少被一个已调研的推理引擎 HTTP API（halogen / gufo / strata / lmstudio / ollama / openai，含其透传面板 panel）真实交付；`api` 字段逐条注明原始遥测出处（端点 + JSON 路径 / Prometheus 指标名）。任何引擎 API 都取不到的一律不入册：NPU / TTS / Embedding 状态、主机磁盘与 SSD 健康、局域网 IP、服务名与容器名、CPU 频率、GPU pstate 与 sclk，以及固件本地累计的 halogen 峰值。

metrics.label: 服务在线
metrics.api: 派生自端点可达：halogen/gufo GET /health 200 | strata GET /v1/status 200 | ollama GET /api/ps 200 | lmstudio GET /api/v0/models 200 | panel GET /api/status .service==active

metrics.label: 模型
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .model | strata GET /v1/status .model | ollama GET /api/ps .models[0].name | lmstudio GET /api/v0/models .data[0].id | openai GET /v1/models .data[0].id | panel GET /api/status .health.model

metrics.label: 引擎版本
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .version.api | strata GET /v1/status .engine | ollama GET /api/version .version | lmstudio GET /api/v0/models .data[0].quantization | panel GET /api/status .health.version.api

metrics.label: 引擎阶段
metrics.api: strata GET /metrics .live.phase（缺省回落 .live.state）| panel GET /api/status .metrics.phase

metrics.label: 正在推理
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .busy | strata GET /metrics .live.running / .live.state∈{reading,generating} | ollama GET /api/ps .models 非空 | panel GET /api/status .health.busy

metrics.label: 已忙时长
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .busy_for_s | GET /metrics halogen:busy_for_seconds | panel GET /api/status .health.busy_for_s

metrics.label: 最长等待
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .longest_wait_s | GET /metrics halogen:queue_wait_longest_seconds | panel GET /api/status .health.longest_wait_s

metrics.label: 引擎响应
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .engine.responds | GET /metrics halogen:engine_up | panel GET /api/status .health.engine.responds

metrics.label: 引擎探测耗时
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .engine.probe_s | panel GET /api/status .health.engine.probe_s

metrics.label: 能力探针
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .capability_probe（ok / failed）| panel GET /api/status .health.capability_probe（透传引擎 /health）

metrics.label: 引擎运行时长
metrics.api: strata GET /v1/status .uptime_s | panel GET /api/status .container_uptime（中文时长换算秒）。halogen 引擎 API 无 uptime，不入册

metrics.label: 解码速度
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:predicted_tokens_seconds（缺省时用 llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total 区间差分）| strata GET /metrics .live.tok_s | panel GET /api/status .metrics.decode_tps

metrics.label: 预填充速度
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:prompt_tokens_seconds（缺省时用 llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total 区间差分）| strata GET /metrics .live.prefill_tok_s_mean | panel GET /api/status .metrics.prefill_tps

metrics.label: 解码均值
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total ÷ llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total | strata GET /metrics .live.tok_s_mean | panel GET /api/status .metrics.decode_tps_avg

metrics.label: 预填充均值
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total ÷ llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total | strata GET /metrics .live.prefill_tok_s_mean | panel GET /api/status .metrics.prefill_tps_avg

metrics.label: 解码峰值
metrics.api: strata GET /metrics .history.tok_s 60 点序列最大值 | panel GET /api/status .metrics.decode_peak。halogen 峰值为固件本地累计而非 API 原始，不入册

metrics.label: 预填充峰值
metrics.api: strata GET /metrics .history.prefill_tok_s_mean 60 点序列最大值 | panel GET /api/status .metrics.prefill_peak

metrics.label: 累计输入 token
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total | strata GET /metrics .totals.prompt_tokens

metrics.label: 累计输出 token
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total | strata GET /metrics .totals.output_tokens

metrics.label: 并发槽位
metrics.api: halogen GET /health .slots | GET /props .total_slots | GET /slots 数组长度 | strata GET /v1/status .concurrency.serving | ollama GET /api/ps .models 长度 | panel GET /api/status .health.slots

metrics.label: 处理中请求
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:requests_processing | GET /health .in_flight | strata GET /metrics .live.running | panel GET /api/status .metrics.requests_processing

metrics.label: 排队请求
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:requests_deferred | GET /health .queued | strata GET /metrics .live.queued + .live.waiting | panel GET /api/status .metrics.requests_deferred

metrics.label: 累计请求
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics halogen:requests_total | strata GET /metrics .totals.requests

metrics.label: 排队放弃
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics halogen:queue_gave_up_total

metrics.label: 等待超 1s 的请求
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics halogen:queue_waited_total

metrics.label: KV 占用
metrics.api: halogen GET /metrics llamacpp:kv_cache_usage_ratio ×100 | GET /cache .pool.usage_ratio ×100 | strata 由 .live.prompt_tokens+.live.generated ÷ .engine.max_context 推算 | panel .metrics.kv_used_tokens ÷ .health.kv_pool_positions

metrics.label: KV 已用
